BiblicalUsage: The word gôdel carries the sense of greatness, majesty, pride. In Numbers 14:19, the text says "the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy." In Deuteronomy 3:24, the text says "thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness."
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: gôdel tells me that God is who He says He is, and His name carries everything He is. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
